name: gy-company-formation
description: How to set up a company in Guyana in 2026, step by step, from the Companies Act, Cap. 89:01 and the Companies Regulations (Laws of Guyana revised edition L.R.O. 1/2012) and the Guyana Revenue Authority (GRA) registration pages. Covers who may incorporate (one or more persons, 18 or over, not bankrupt), the company and the public company, no-par shares and no minimum capital, at least one director (two for a public company), the secretary, the registered office, name reservation for 12 months, the articles of incorporation and the documents filed with the Registrar of Companies, the attorney's statutory declaration, the certificate of incorporation, registry fees (G$60,000 incorporation, G$800 name reservation), external (foreign) companies registering within one month, the TIN from the GRA (G$1,000), the annual general meeting and annual return, strike-off and fines. Trigger phrases: set up a company in Guyana, incorporate in Guyana, Guyana company registration, external company Guyana
